modules.title: 从克隆到启动：依赖在哪一步进入项目
依赖为什么需要单独安装

items.title: 项目只存清单，不存依赖本身
items.text: 仓库里通常只有一份记录文件，写着项目需要哪些包和版本；依赖本体按需下载，不进版本库。

items.title: 安装准备本机的依赖目录
items.text: 包管理器读取清单和锁文件，下载或复用所需包并准备本地安装目录；新克隆项目或依赖变化后，通常要按项目说明重新安装。

items.title: 报错对应不同原因
items.text: Cannot find module 先怀疑没装依赖；装过仍报错，再看版本是否匹配、是不是代码引用路径写错。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 安装成功不代表项目能跑：还需要版本满足要求、配置完整。安装失败时，先看清是哪个包、网络问题还是版本冲突，再决定重试还是调整版本。

lessonPractice.title: 新克隆的项目运行 npm start 时报 Cannot find module 'react'。下一步怎么做？

options.label: 先运行 npm install 安装依赖，再重新启动项目
options.feedback: 对。克隆下来的项目通常不含依赖本身，只含记录；先安装再运行是正常流程。

options.label: 让 AI 把 import react 的代码删掉重写
options.feedback: 报错说明依赖没装，不是代码写错；删代码会破坏功能。

options.label: 重新安装 Node.js，因为模块找不到是环境问题
options.feedback: Node.js 存在时，先装项目依赖；node 本身缺失会有不同的报错（command not found）。

en.title: A newly cloned project reports Cannot find module 'react' when running npm start. What should happen next?

options.label: Run npm install first, then start the project again
options.feedback: Correct. A cloned project usually contains the dependency records, not the packages themselves. Installing first is the normal flow.

options.label: Ask AI to rewrite the code without importing react
options.feedback: The error says dependencies are missing, not that the code is wrong; removing imports breaks the feature.

options.label: Reinstall Node.js because a missing module is an environment problem
options.feedback: When Node.js exists, install the project's dependencies first; a missing node itself produces a different error (command not found).

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 刚克隆的项目运行时报 Cannot find module。请先运行安装依赖的命令，确认依赖清单里的包都装好，再重新启动。如果安装失败，说明是哪个包装不上、为什么，不要改业务代码绕过。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The freshly cloned project reports Cannot find module. Run the dependency install command first, confirm every package in the manifest is installed, then start again. If installation fails, explain which package failed and why instead of working around it in business code.

learning.assumes: You have seen projects require an install step, or hit a missing-module error.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether a missing-module error means dependencies were never installed, the version is wrong, or the code itself is broken.

modules.title: From clone to start: when dependencies enter the project
Why dependencies need a separate install step

items.title: The project stores a list, not the packages
items.text: The repository usually tracks a manifest and may track a lockfile; the install directory is commonly generated locally rather than committed.

items.title: Installing prepares the local dependency directory
items.text: The package manager reads the manifest and lockfile, downloads or reuses required packages, and prepares a local install directory. A fresh clone or dependency change usually needs installation as documented by the project.

items.title: Errors map to different causes
items.text: Cannot find module first suggests dependencies were never installed. If it persists after installing, check the version match and whether the import path is wrong.

modules.title: What success does not guarantee
modules.text: A successful install does not mean the project runs: versions must still match and configuration must be complete. When installation fails, identify which package failed and why before retrying or adjusting versions.

distinctions.label: npm
distinctions.text: npm is the tool that installs and manages dependencies; a dependency is one of the packages it installs into the project.

distinctions.label: Your own source code
distinctions.text: Dependencies are external packages declared and resolved by the package manager; your own files belong to the project repository. Changes to either may need a rebuild or refresh before they appear.
